chronology.sparql:
PREFIX a: <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ontology#>
PREFIX m: <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ontology/members#>
PREFIX f: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>
PREFIX s: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX dcat: <http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX dl: <http://data.europa.eu/eli/eli-draft-legislation-ontology#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?term ?label ?start ?end WHERE { GRAPH <https://data.oireachtas.ie/graph/houses> {?term a ?type; s:prefLabel ?label; dct:temporal ?period. VALUES ?type {a:DailTerm a:SeanadTerm} ?period dcat:startDate ?start. OPTIONAL {?period dcat:endDate ?end.}} } ORDER BY ?term ?label ?start ?end

graph_counts.sparql: SELECT ?g (COUNT(*) AS ?triples) WHERE {GRAPH ?g {?s ?p ?o}} GROUP BY ?g ORDER BY ?g

ambiguity_murphy.sparql:
PREFIX a: <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ontology#>
PREFIX m: <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ontology/members#>
PREFIX f: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>
PREFIX s: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX dcat: <http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX dl: <http://data.europa.eu/eli/eli-draft-legislation-ontology#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?person ?name WHERE { GRAPH ?g {?person a a:Member; f:name ?name; m:hasMembersMembership ?ms. ?ms a m:DailMembership.} FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?name)), "murphy")) } ORDER BY ?person ?name
